It is a copy rather than a consumed file because Medusa resolves corpusDirectory and the compilation target relative to the working directory. targetContractsBalances is 1000 ether because every dispute is funded at construction out of the harness's own balance — the deposit IS the constructor's msg.value — so a zero-balance harness could not open a single dispute and conservation, the cap and solvency would all hold vacuously.
